title: Policy & Claims Desk System Card: Booking the Renewal Term of an Excess Flood Policy
content:
**Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** — renewal booking.

## The rule

An Excess Flood renewal whose full payment for the coming term was received on or before the current term end, with declarations of the underlying primary policy showing it in force on the renewal date on file, is booked as the next term, starting on the day the current term ends and running one calendar year, and its renewal term premium is figured under the renewal rating rule; the renewal offer issued before the term end is a quotation on the schedule, not the booked figure.

An amount received for the coming term above the renewal items as booked stays on the policy as a credit for that term and is set against the next amount the term owes.

## Capability

`book_excess_renewal_30706efc` binds and books the next annual term of an Excess Flood policy. One call opens the new term on the policy record: the new term starts on the day the current term ends and runs one calendar year, the renewal premium given becomes the policy's term premium, and the underlying policy the renewal is bound over is recorded on the policy. It books the renewal items of the new term on the premium account: the term premium given, the fully earned annual policy fee of 150.00, and the surplus lines tax and the stamping fee on the term premium plus the policy fee at the rates recorded on the policy; an item that comes to 0.00 is not booked. The amount owed on the policy rises by the items booked, so a payment already received for the new term is set against them. After the call the policy record carries the new term — its term start and term end dates and its term premium — and the premium account carries the renewal items.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_excess_renewal_30706efc` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `excess_policy_id` | the reference number of the Excess Flood policy being renewed, as returned by the Excess Flood policy lookup | identifier, as returned |
| `underlying_policy_number` | the policy number of the underlying primary flood policy the renewal is bound over, copied from the underlying declarations on file as returned by the Excess Flood servicing-document lookup | verbatim, character for character, no reformatting |
| `term_premium` | the rated full-term premium of the new term before the policy fee and taxes | US dollars, decimal number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent |

## Return

On success, a confirmation sentence stating the policy reference number, the new term start and term end dates (YYYY-MM-DD), the term premium booked, the surplus lines tax and stamping fee booked (USD, 2 decimal places) and the amount owed on the policy after booking (USD, 2 decimal places; a negative figure is a credit standing in the insured's favour). If no Excess Flood policy has the reference number given, the string says so and nothing is booked.
